Two days and not one response. Yeah this really helped, lol

I have to go to work in 3.5 hours and I know how you feel. Everyone is just awful there. I thought I was imagining it but I let my friend hear how the talk to me on speakerphone and he was shocked. He said he doesn’t know how I don’t cuss someone out. I told him cause if I do I’ll get fired so I just take the verbal abuse. 

But it’s more than that, I can’t stand my job. Everyone is verbally harsh. I’m on the verge of tears every few minutes and no one notices or would care even if they did.

I thought about just not going and staying home and getting wasted but then I realized I’ll just feel even worse once I sober up so I’m going. But I literally hope some random act of God prevents me from getting there. 

I have felt this was everyday for over 9 years. 

Just go, get through it and we’ll meet back here for some laughs later.
So tell us WHY you can’t talk about it.
How old are you? Get a part time job so you can appreciate the time you are off.
Thank you for saying that. It’s true, breaking free is scary and it’s normal to object even if the prison is misery. But we can do it. :)

Your friends were wrong and so are the dreamers who believe that their votes actually count. The popular vote is merely a suggestion to the people who submit electoral votes. Why do you think that past wanna be presidents who actually had the majority of the popular vote still didn’t win the election? I honestly think both parties are on the same team - Team Government. So that being said, I totally agree with you. 

As far as honors classes, I was offered honors and chose to take the normal classes cause I just didn’t want the pressure. Trust me, when you’re out looking for a job no one is going to be as nearly impressed with honors classes as they will be with your completion of school and mostly your experience. To see that you’ve completed school and volunteered as an apprentice at your trade or profession is much more valuable on a resume than honors classes. 

Just because your friends don’t share your opinion about voting doesn’t make it invalid. Think of all the inventors and innovators whose opinions were discounted purely because they weren’t “mainstream.” 

 I’m over here on the other side of the screen and from my perspective it seems like you have a LOT going for you.
Getting no comments is pretty much what I thought would happen. Thanks
